title: Verogen ForenSeq DNA Signature Prep Kit Part 1/5: PCR1 Setup
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Add master mix to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Add the pre‑prepared PCR1 master mix to a clean PCR plate as supplied with the Verogen ForenSeq DNA Signature Prep kit.

steps.title: Create CSV transfer file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file that includes the header line and the columns: volume (µL), source plate # (1‑4), source column (1‑12), destination column (1‑12). Example rows: 8,1,2,1; 8,2,3,2; 8,2,12,3.

steps.title: Transfer samples according to CSV
steps.instruction: For each row in the CSV, program the pipette to:

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the specified volume from the indicated source plate and column, using the slot specified and setting the aspiration height to the desired distance from the bottom of the well.
Dispense the aspirated volume into the indicated destination column of the PCR plate (the plate containing master mix), using the slot specified for the destination.
Repeat the aspiration and dispense actions for every line in the CSV until all samples are transferred.
